title: Nik's Craftables - Back to Basics
description: Adds 562 crafting recipes to revert items back to their basic materials.
body:
![purple text in the style of minecraft's logo that reads "CRAFTABLES"](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/eccdd03eda4eebaaf673eae9f78a289d03cc3314.png)

Adds crafting recipes to revert items to their basic materials. Theres a total of 562 new crafting recipes.

Too many items to sort? No problem! Simply craft it back to its original material!! Unlock the recipes by crafting a knowledge book, which is crafted with a book and an emerald.


<details>
<summary>Some Crafting Recipes</summary>
  
- wool -> string
- carpet -> string
- mangrove root -> sticks
- muddy mangrove root -> mud
- (smelt) mud -> dirt
- copper blocks & items -> copper ingots
- stained glass & glass panes (+water bucket) -> glass & glass panes
- stairs, slabs, fences, fence gates, doors, trapdoors, walls, buttons, pressure plates, shelves, signs, hanging signs, boats -> planks, stripped logs, stones, or metals
- dyed terracotta -> terracotta
- dyed shulker boxes -> plain shulker box
- dyed wool (+water bucket) -> white wool
- dyed candles -> plain candles
- amethyst cluster stages -> amethyst shards
- amethyst shards -> cluster stages
- string -> cobweb
- blue ice -> packed ice -> ice
- coal, copper, iron, diamonds, etc (+stone/deepslate) -> ore blocks [THIS IS BALANCED WITH FORTUNE I SWEAR ITS NOT OP]
- leather & chain armor -> leather & chains
- dried ghast -> ghast tear
- resin blocks -> resin
  
hopefully that is all i really dont know
</details>



<details>
<summary>Blasting Recipes</summary>
  
cant see these in game but they work i swear

- blast copper, iron, gold, diamond, and netherite armor (horse and nautilus too!) to get ingots back rather than nuggets.
- blast oxidized & waxed copper items to bring it back to its original stage (golems and copper chests too!) (you can also craft the original stage back into copper ingots)
- blast polished or smooth blocks to unpolish them
- blast cracked blocks to uncrack(?) them
- blast (some) brick blocks (not Bricks, like stone bricks) into their base block
- blast concrete back into concrete powder!

basically when in doubt pop it in the blast furnace it might do something tbh

</details>
